transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?
Lately I keep thinking my family might be better off without me, and those thoughts are starting to scare me. I've never felt this way before, and my wife convinced me that I needed to get some help.

When you feel this depressed, have you heard voices, seen things others don’t, or become convinced of something that others say isn’t true? Also, have you ever had a similar episode of depression before this one?

No, I’ve never heard voices or seen things that weren't there, and I don't have any beliefs like that. But as for the depression, I’ve had these heavy lows alternating with times when I feel really revved up and full of big plans coming and going for several years now, though this is definitely the worst it's ever been.
During this worst low, have you still been able to do basic daily things like get out of bed, eat, and wash yourself, or has the depression made that nearly impossible?

I manage to get out of bed and do some basic washing, but even those simple things feel incredibly heavy and exhausting, like I'm trying to move through mud. Because of that, my wife has had to take care of almost everything else around the house and with the bills just to keep us afloat.
